title: Fields and struct literals
hints: The compiler says Point has no field Y. A struct type lists every field it has, each with a name and a type.
NewPoint promises to return a *Point, but p is a Point. The & operator takes the address of a struct value, so &p (or &Point{...}) is a *Point.
type Point struct { X, Y int } and, in NewPoint, return &Point{X: x, Y: y}.
